sampling_note: Collected during apple bloom; one 24-hour sampling period.

colour_data_description: Image-derived colour states (calibrated CIELAB, frozen 21-state colour basis). Not plant taxa; not reflectance.
measurement_limitations: Calibration extrapolated or out of gamut for 15.2% of retained pixels; blue channel clipped to 0 for 12.9% (chroma is a lower bound there); calibrated chart warm-patch error 2.8 dE00 (held out).
selection_note: Shown as an example only. Chosen by a fixed rule (the analysed sample closest to its crop system's median v1 colour Shannon); not representative of apple samples.
